subject: Staggered MAP: SOC 2 & SIG gating + DPA retention carveouts
messages:
From: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@finbridge.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: Erin Shaw <erin.shaw@finbridge.com>, legal@finbridge.com
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP starter - security gating / retention

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the kickoff call today. To move forward with a mutual action plan we need clarity on a few gating items from Redwood: SOC 2 Type II (most recent report), SIG/CAIQ mapping or answers, the current DPA (we've attached our standard redline for context), and firm commitments on data retention windows for logs, backups, and customer data.

Specifically FinBridge legal and security have asked for:
- SOC 2 Type II report delivered or SOC 2 in-progress with compensating controls timeline
- Completed SIG/CAIQ matrix for production controls that touch data residency and access
- DPA redline comments addressed (we've attached our redline; see comments on Sections 4 & 7)
- Retention windows: proposed defaults and any carveouts (e.g., backups 7 years, logs 12 months, ML training data none)

We're aiming to finalize MAP milestones by Aug 6 so procurement can sign off before our quarter close. Can Redwood share a proposed staged MAP that allows us to start a pilot while longer items (DPA negotiation, SOC 2 evidence) are being completed?

Thanks — appreciate a clear, staged path.

—Miguel
CTO, FinBridge

Attachments: (none in this message; FinBridge's redline was uploaded to their portal and shared separately)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@finbridge.com>
Cc: Erin Shaw <erin.shaw@finbridge.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP starter - security gating / retention

Miguel —

Thanks for the clear list. Attached are two artifacts to accelerate the MAP: a one-page SOC 2 summary (SOC2-Summary-Redwood-2027.pdf) and our SIG/CAIQ mapping workbook (SIG-CAIQ-Mapping-FinBridge.xlsx). I've proposed a "staggered acceptance" approach so FinBridge can begin a scoped pilot while we complete contractual and audit artifacts. High level: 

Stage A (pilot / limited production - up to 50k API tokens/day):
- Preconditions: SOC 2 summary + completed SIG answers (attached)
- Controls required: customer data residency (US), encryption at rest & in transit, access controls + MFA for console users
- Retention: application data retention default = 90 days; request logs retention = 12 months; backups retention (disaster recovery) = 7 years (policy, not customer-visible retention)
- DPA: Redwood will sign a short-term addendum (DocuSign link below) for pilot that references the final DPA negotiation in Stage B
- Timeline target: Stage A ready in 5 business days from FinBridge acceptance

Stage B (full commercial / contract execution):
- Preconditions: full SOC 2 Type II report or issuance plan with milestone dates; completed SIG workbook with evidence links; finalized DPA with negotiated carveouts
- Acceptance: FinBridge security review and joint acceptance test (security workshop)
- Timeline target: DPA + SOC2 resolution within 4–6 weeks (we'll prioritize)

We can also support specific retention carveouts (e.g., extended backups) via contractual SLAs and appendix. If FinBridge wants escrow for key material/escrow of logs, we can discuss an escrow addendum — that's not standard but achievable for enterprise deals.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Confirm FinBridge can accept Stage A controls so we can enable pilot credentials.
2) Erin — could you upload your DPA redline to the shared Drive link so our legal can pull change-tracking?
3) Schedule a 60-minute security workshop (this week) to walk SIG answers and evidence.

DocuSign (pilot addendum): https://www.docusign.com/en/doc/FB-DPA-Redline
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3Redwood-FinBridge-MAP
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/FB-2028-034

Attachments: SOC2-Summary-Redwood-2027.pdf (1 page), SIG-CAIQ-Mapping-FinBridge.xlsx

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai

From: Erin Shaw <erin.shaw@finbridge.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@finbridge.com>
Cc: legal@finbridge.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 12:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP starter - security gating / retention

Naomi —

Thanks for the staged proposal and the artifacts. A few clarifications from Legal/Security after a quick pass through the attachments: 

- The SOC2 summary helps but FinBridge requires either the full SOC 2 Type II report (redacted OK) or a formal attestation letter from your auditor confirming the reporting period and scope. Please advise timing.
- SIG workbook: helpful, but we need evidence links for the controls you marked "partial" (especially around key management and backups). Could you flag owner and ETA for each incomplete item?
- DPA: I've attached our redline (we will upload to the Drive as requested). Main sticking points: Section 4 (Data Processing & Purpose) and Section 7 (Retention & Deletion) — we propose a tighter retention on backups (3 years) and an audit clause for on-demand access to logs for incident response.

We can accept the pilot under Stage A provided Redwood agrees to: 
1) Provide the auditor attestation or SOC2 report within 30 days of pilot start, and
2) Execute a pilot addendum that includes (a) an obligation to complete DPA negotiation in good faith within 45 days, and (b) a retention affidavit for backups and logs.

I'll attach the DPA-redline-v2.docx here for Redwood legal.

—Erin
Senior Counsel, FinBridge

Attachments: DPA-redline-v2.docx

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Shaw <erin.shaw@finbridge.com>, Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@finbridge.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP starter - security gating / retention

Erin / Miguel —

Appreciate the specificity. Quick clarifications from our side and a refined MAP timeline: 

1) SOC 2: We can provide either the full SOC 2 Type II report (redacted for customer data) or an auditor attestation within 14 calendar days. If FinBridge needs the full report before pilot activation, please confirm and we'll expedite.

2) SIG evidence: We'll flag owners inside the workbook and provide evidence links for the "partial" controls within 10 business days. Marcus will be the point for key management/backups evidence.

3) DPA & Retention: Redwood is willing to commit to the pilot addendum terms: good-faith negotiation window (45 days) and a retention affidavit. On backup retention, we typically keep disaster recovery snapshots for 7 years for regulatory reasons; we can offer a contractual cap at 3 years for customer-visible retention and provide a written technical appendix describing immutable backup handling.

Revised timeline (proposed):
- Aug 3: FinBridge accepts Stage A terms — pilot addendum executed via DocuSign.
- Aug 4–Aug 17: Redwood delivers auditor attestation or full SOC2 report, and updated SIG evidence links.
- Aug 18–Sep 20: Parallel DPA negotiation window (45 days) with weekly check-ins.

We will also run a 60-minute workshop on Aug 5 (proposed 11:00 AM PT) to walk SIG evidence and the pilot controls.

On the escrow/keys question from the earlier thread: Marcus (copied) can sketch an escrow path outside the MAP if needed.

On quoting Miguel's earlier point:
> "Can Redwood share a proposed staged MAP that allows us to start a pilot while longer items (DPA negotiation, SOC 2 evidence) are being completed?"

Yes — that's the plan above. If FinBridge confirms acceptance of Stage A we will enable the pilot environment and provide the requested artifacts on the timeline.

Jonas Weber
VP, Customer Success Operations, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
